name: La Trobe Student Union Safety Net voucher
summary: A one-off $60 prepaid voucher for Bundoora students facing urgent or unexpected costs like food, bills or rent.
who: Currently enrolled at La Trobe's Melbourne Bundoora campus.
Facing urgent or unexpected financial difficulty.
how: Complete the online form when it's open. Supporting documents are optional.
catches: Closed for now because funding has run out. The Student Union hopes to reopen it next semester.
Not for La Trobe College, other campuses or online-only students.
